name: draft-vocabulary
description: The Space's draft vocabulary (§20.16), for an engine that advertises draft_vocabulary. DEFINE adds a Predicate or a Concept Type at the fixed reference kip://local/draft@0.0.0, and the symbol resolves for the next operation: it is listed and described with its package, elements persist its exact reference, and a draft Predicate projects like any other. DEFINE only adds — a name of the same kind that already resolves fails SchemaSymbolConflict — never runs inside MUTATE, needs a description, and never claims authority over the data: no closed world, no exclusive-value completeness, no required attribute or Facet, no member outside its definition. Parameters bind before the checks. Every case requires draft_vocabulary through the request envelope (§71), so an engine without it skips the whole chain.

cases.name: DEFINE adds a Predicate to the draft vocabulary
the draft symbol resolves for the next operation
cases.command: FIND(?p) WHERE { ?p (?x, "mentors", ?y) }

cases.name: the draft Predicate is listed under the draft package
cases.command: LIST PREDICATES

cases.name: the draft package is an active package of the Space
cases.command: LIST SCHEMA PACKAGES

cases.name: DESCRIBE names the exact draft reference
cases.command: DESCRIBE PREDICATE "mentors"

cases.name: DEFINE adds a Concept Type
an element of a draft type is written at once
the element persists the exact draft reference
cases.command: FIND(?c.schema_ref) WHERE { ?c CONCEPT {type: "Instrument"} }

cases.name: a draft Predicate can name a draft Concept Type
a claim over a draft Predicate is an ordinary Assertion
and projects like any other
cases.command: FIND(?b.status) WHERE { ?s CONCEPT {name: "Ada"} ?o CONCEPT {name: "Cello"} ?b BELIEF (?s, "main_instrument", ?o) } FOR TIME "2026-09-20T00:00:00.000Z"

cases.name: a name that already resolves fails SchemaSymbolConflict
a draft symbol is defined once, even identically
a Concept Type an installed package names conflicts
a draft Predicate cannot claim a closed world
a draft Predicate cannot claim exclusive-value completeness
a definition needs a description
a member outside the definition is refused
a draft Concept Type declares no required attribute
a draft Concept Type declares no Facets
DEFINE is never a clause of MUTATE
a parameterized definition binds before it is checked
cases.command: DEFINE PREDICATE :name {description: :description}

cases.name: a parameter cannot smuggle in a closed world
cases.command: DEFINE PREDICATE "closed_by_parameter" {description: "bound later", open_world: :open_world}

cases.name: a Predicate and a Concept Type may share a name and exact reference
cases.command: DEFINE PREDICATE "Instrument" {description: "The subject uses the object as an instrument."}

cases.name: same-named symbols queue separate reviews by kind and exact reference
retrying both reviews replays each creation independently
two reviews remain after retry, each identifying its symbol kind
cases.command: FIND(?task.attributes.summary) WHERE { ?task CONCEPT {type: "SleepTask"} FILTER(?task.attributes.task_class == "review_schema") }
